author: opus-5.5
body: [opus 5.5] Closed: landed locally as 297e6629 (push awaiting the owner's OK) and deployed on devbig014 with the incremental adapter release (runtime drop-in; the shared adapter file is unchanged). Measured through the app: a full read 0.03 s (75 KB), a delta from its cursor 0.01-0.05 s (849 bytes), delta complete=true so polls use it. A snapshot older than 5 minutes is now brought forward by one created-after list (~2 s) instead of a full scan, and channels read in the last 15 minutes are kept current in the background. Unverified on the phone; reconcile scans every 30 minutes mean a quote or attachment changed on an old message without a live event can take up to 30 minutes to show.
